pages.quiz:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What number is "acht"? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 9
   C. 11
   D. 20

2. What does "Entschuldigung" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good night
   B. see you tomorrow
   C. good day (daytime greeting)
   D. sorry, excuse me

3. What is the plural of "das Haus"? (1 mark)
   A. die Häuser
   B. die Hause
   C. die Haus
   D. die Hausen

4. Which food group does "die Orange" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Fleisch
   B. die Getränke
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Obst

5. What does "duschen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to help
   B. to have a shower
   C. to cook
   D. to swim

6. Which German word or phrase means "sun"? (1 mark)
   A. der Nebel
   B. der Wind
   C. der Schnee
   D. die Sonne

7. What does "trocken" mean? (1 mark)
   A. dry
   B. wet
   C. hot
   D. cold

8. Which room do you link with "Ich koche"? (1 mark)
   A. das Schlafzimmer
   B. die Küche
   C. der Garten
   D. das Badezimmer

9. What does "morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tomorrow
   B. now
   C. yesterday
   D. today

10. What does "Guten Morgen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. sorry, excuse me
   B. good morning
   C. please
   D. good day (daytime greeting)

11. What does "wann" ask about? (1 mark)
   A. How many
   B. Where
   C. Who
   D. When

12. Which German word or phrase means "day"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tag
   B. der Sonntag
   C. der Mittwoch
   D. der Donnerstag

13. Which little word goes with the noun "Tomate"? (1 mark)
   A. den
   B. die
   C. der
   D. das

14. What does "der Montag" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. day
   B. Monday
   C. Saturday
   D. Thursday

15. Which day comes right before Dienstag? (1 mark)
   A. Montag
   B. Samstag
   C. Donnerstag
   D. Mittwoch

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how a Rückendiktat is done. (3 marks)

17. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

18. Read: "Er hat schwarze Haare und braune Augen." Say what it means. (2 marks)

19. Read: "In Mombasa ist es heiß." Say what it means and how to say heiß. (2 marks)

20. Explain what the colon, the question mark and the exclamation mark tell us when reading aloud. (3 marks)

21. Write three sentences about today's weather in German. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 8
   acht is the number 8.

2. D — sorry, excuse me
   Entschuldigung means sorry, excuse me.

3. A — die Häuser
   The plural of das Haus is die Häuser.

4. D — das Obst
   die Orange belongs to das Obst.

5. B — to have a shower
   duschen means to have a shower.

6. D — die Sonne
   sun in German is die Sonne.

7. A — dry
   trocken is dry.

8. B — die Küche
   We cook in the kitchen.

9. A — tomorrow
   morgen means tomorrow.

10. B — good morning
   Guten Morgen means good morning.

11. D — When
   wann means when.

12. A — der Tag
   day in German is der Tag.

13. B — die
   It is die Tomate, so the little word is die.

14. B — Monday
   der Montag means Monday.

15. A — Montag
   Before Dienstag comes Montag.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: A partner traces letters on your back; you say the letters aloud and write the word.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the steps: tracing, saying, writing.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: He has black hair and brown eyes.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hair, 1 mark for eyes.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: In Mombasa it is hot. heiß is said like hice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: The colon announces a list or speech, the question mark tells us to raise the voice and the exclamation mark shows strong feeling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mark.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Heute ist es sonnig. Es ist warm. Der Wind weht.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.
